notes.title: Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36535739/2a5e6b98eb593bf9f16715d602148aeff72efb77.jpg

Thanks again for all your constructive feedback! We really appreciate your commitment!

Thanks to your great support, we were able to correct some bugs and implement further new features and improvements.

Here's the changelog:


    Fix: Problems with the savegames were fixed.
    Fix: Problems with items and the UI have been fixed.
    Fix: Some performance improvements.
    Fix: Dialog and quest errors have been fixed.
    Fix: Some items had wrong names, has now been fixed.
    Fix: Card on floor 6 was missing, this is now available.
    Fix: Problems with the mirrors have been fixed.
    Improvements: Some quests have been adjusted based on player feedback, some were too difficult, some were too easy.
    Improvements: Patient and item names are now displayed when selected.

 
We'd love to hear your feedback on these improvements.





Thanks again for your support!

DaRa Games
